reason: Ask Nebula could not open over any conversation or with a harness assistant: #939 made ChatService.session_messages and HarnessRuntimeService.create_session async but POST /chat/temporary-sessions still called both without await (TypeError 'coroutine' object is not subscriptable / AttributeError on harness.model/.id). The fix awaits both. Selected: the popup route suite (its create() helper now awaits the client, the harness fork test awaits an AsyncMock, and two new tests drive the real route over a real HarnessRuntimeService), the execution-scope suite with the new worker-context Ask Nebula route test (provider and harness, the route a project worker runs for this chat-start command), and the expired-popup collector case of the same router.
exclusions: test_chat_workspace.py and test_chat_decisions.py exercise neighbouring side-chat/fork code but each has a test-only unawaited call that fails identically on pristine main (_walk does not await client.get; test_chat_decisions does not await fork_session), so they are not selected. Only the popup-collector case of test_control_plane_reads.py is selected: its other cases do not use this route and test_mixed_settings_read_burst_retains_capacity_after_cancellation is load-sensitive on this host (fails on pristine main under PostgreSQL, passes alone). test_runtime_delivery.py passes on main and branch but its chat-start classification is unchanged. PostgreSQL variants of test_execution_scope.py were run locally (all pass); CI runs the SQLite variants. No UI, native or Playwright cases: no frontend code changed; the real-Core Playwright popup journey in real-core.spec.ts is not run on main. Scratch supervisor Core evidence (provider popup, harness popup with and without an open harness chat, discard) is in the PR body.
